description: Query canonical feature records derived from aggregate-safe observations. Returns versioned feature IDs, transform metadata, leakage-safe inputs, and public training-candidate labels.

as_of_date.description: Optional feature as-of date such as '2025-12-31'.

asset_id.description: Optional feature asset identifier such as 'benchmark.normalized_training_panels_candidate'.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier, currently a tract GEOID20 such as '48201231400'.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

metric_id.description: Optional metric identifier such as 'total_population' or 'median_hh_income'.

period_end.description: Optional ISO date upper bound such as '2025-12-31'.

period_start.description: Optional ISO date lower bound such as '2024-01-01'.

name: query_features

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: Query Features
